description: This file defines a generic serializer class 'ConcreteTypeSerializer' for reference types that can be instantiated, implementing the 'IFieldCodec' interface. It handles serialization and deserialization of objects, including reference tracking, type checking, and object creation via an activator.

classes.name: ConcreteTypeSerializer
classes.description: A generic serializer class for reference types that can be instantiated, supporting serialization and deserialization with reference tracking.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value, handling nulls, type checks, and reference tracking.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value, handling reference types and type mismatches.

methods.name: ReadValueSealed
methods.description: Deserializes a value in a sealed manner, handling references.
